page: Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized server instance designed for intensive parallel computing workloads. It features 104 vCPUs powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8481C processors operating at 2.7 GHz, with 52 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The system includes 936 GB of system memory, providing 9.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by four bundled NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a total of 320 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of 3216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity.

Benchmark evaluations indicate top-tier multi-core and specialized instruction performance. The instance achieved a PassMark CPU score of 86938.94, placing it in the top 10% tier, alongside a top-tier rating in Geekbench image processing. Multi-core stress-ng CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores are categorized as strong, supported by Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions and Advanced Vector Extensions. Large-block memory read bandwidth reached 216.58 GB/sec, while write bandwidth registered at 95.09 GB/sec. For language model execution, text generation speeds reached 38.11 tokens/sec for a medium 7B model and 4.61 tokens/sec for a large 70B model.

Given the high-density integration of four enterprise-grade H100 GPUs, dedicated Intel Xeon processors, and local NVMe storage, this instance represents a high-capital hardware class optimized for resource density rather than low-cost general-purpose hosting. The inclusion of specialized hardware accelerators and high memory bandwidth makes it highly efficient for large-scale machine learning training, LLM inference, ray tracing, and complex scientific simulations.
